name: Real Alto manioc processing
description: A household at Real Alto in coastal Ecuador processed manioc roots as part of a mixed crop economy, evidenced by residues on stone tools.

impact.note: One household's residues show an already domesticated root in use at one coastal settlement, with nothing later known to rest on it.
